stock.description: Radiance Holdings (Group) Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in property development business in Mainland China. The company develops and sells residential and commercial properties; and leases commercial properties, such as office buildings, shopping malls, and shopping streets. It also provides management consulting services related to construction, sales and marketing of properties, and project management; and business management and hotel services. Radiance Holdings (Group) Company Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
